title: Monicity of restriction on an ideal twist
statement: Let $i:X\hookrightarrow Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-closed-immersion] and $I$ an ideal sheaf [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Suppose $I(U)\cap\ker(i)(U)=0$ on every open $U$ of $Y$. Let $M$ be invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], $m\ge0$, $N=M^{\otimes m}$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and let $\eta$ be the unit of the chosen module tensor-pullback adjunction [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write $\mu:I\otimes N\to N$ for multiplication. Then $\operatorname{im}(\mu)\hookrightarrow N\xrightarrow{\eta_N}i_*i^*N$ is a monomorphism of module sheaves.

source.place: Remark remark-conductor, final sentence, and the local trivialization argument used in Lemma lemma-dim-1-noetherian-reduced-separated-has-ample

proof.text: Put N=M tensor-power m. Choose an affine basis trivializing N; on V=Spec A, i inverse-image V=Spec B is given by a surjection A -> B with kernel J. Quasi-coherence identifies the multiplication image with K=I(V). The canonical unit on this image is the quotient map K -> B. Its kernel is K intersection J, zero by hzero V. When B=0, J=A and hzero gives K=0.

A difference of sections killed by restriction is zero on every basis open and hence zero by sheaf separatedness. Thus the sheaf morphism is mono. Compare the chosen adjunction with the canonical one by uniqueness of left adjoints; their units differ by postcomposition with pushforward of an isomorphism on N, which preserves monicity.

theorem closedImmersion_disjointIdeal_twist_mono {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (I : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (hzero : ∀ U : Y.Opens, I.idealOfOpens U ⊓ i.ker.idealOfOpens U = ⊥)
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] (m : ℕ) :
    let adj := Classical.choice (nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)
    let μ := I.toModulesι ▷ M.tensorPow m ≫ (λ_ (M.tensorPow m)).hom
    Mono (image.ι μ ≫ adj.unit.app (M.tensorPow m))
